Spring policy on clear signage
The aim of this section is to explain the routine in plain words

Clear signage helps travellers move through the Companion Animal Travel Desk with confidence, and we regret any confusion that arises when notices are missing or unclear. Staff must place pet route signs where customers can see them, use simple wording, and keep instructions consistent across Aurelia Skyways locations. When a traveler asks for help, give calm guidance and confirm the next step without delay. <<FACT F011>> If a pet must wait, offer a suitable holding area and explain the reason in respectful language. Records should note any service issue, special handling need, or welfare concern in plain terms. <<FACT F003>> If a notice becomes worn, faded, or hard to read, replace it at once and advise the senior coordinator. For any uncertainty, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk promptly.
